Subject: Coordinating a cross-region demo — two quick windows to choose from

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to show how Redwood can help Atlas Retail reduce inference cost while improving peak latency. Because your execs are US-based and our engineering team will join from Berlin, I wanted to propose two compact options to minimize folks being on at awkward hours: 

- Option A (exec-focused, concise): 10:30 AM ET / 16:30 CEST (30 minutes) — live demo + key metrics, ideal for leadership.
- Option B (engineer deep-dive): 11:00 AM ET / 17:00 CEST (60 minutes) — hands-on with our infra engineers for integration questions.

We can run Option A as a short executive walkthrough and keep Option B as the optional technical deep-dive; we’ll record the deep-dive and share notes so anyone who can’t make it can catch up.

Attached: agenda (atlas-demo-agenda-v1.pdf) and a quick timezone matrix I made (timezone-matrix.xlsx).

Do either of those windows work for Wed 2 June? If neither, tell me a preferred morning ET and I’ll coordinate on our side — the main constraint is our Berlin infra engineers prefer not to start before 15:00 CEST.

Thanks,
Marissa
